description: Save a URL + JSON format as a PulpMiner API (POST /external/ai/json/save). Afterwards the data is available at {baseUrl}/external/{apiId} with the `apikey` header (see pulpminer_fetch_api_data). For a dynamic API, pass dynamicUrl with {{ variable }} placeholders, e.g. https://site.com/search?q={{ query }}; callers then supply those variables. Saving itself is free; each later fetch costs 0.4 credits (+0.1 with renderJs). Needs only the PulpMiner API key (PULPMINER_API_KEY locally, or `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on the hosted server).

cache.description: Cache results: serve cached JSON (24h TTL) and refresh in the background when older than 15 min.

dynamicUrl.description: Optional URL template with {{ variable }} placeholders. When set the API becomes dynamic and must be called with variables.

extraLLMInfo.description: Extra natural-language instructions for the LLM, e.g. 'only the first 10 products, prices as numbers'.

jsonFormat.description: Required. The JSON shape the API should return, usually the output of pulpminer_generate_json (values can be left as examples).

llm.description: LLM used to convert HTML to JSON. llm_2 = OpenAI GPT (default), llm_1 = Google Gemini, llm_3 = Groq (only if enabled for the account; otherwise the API returns 'bad request').

renderJs.description: Render JavaScript in a headless browser before extracting (default true; adds 0.1 credits).

scraper.description: Scraper backend. scraper_1 (default, supports useSession) or scraper_2. Try the other one if a site blocks scraping.

selector.description: CSS selector to limit extraction to part of the page, e.g. "main" or "#results". Default: whole body.

url.description: Page URL the API scrapes (for dynamic APIs: an example URL with real values).

useSession.description: Use a persistent scraping session (scraper_1 only; ignored for lifetime-plan accounts).

name: pulpminer_save_as_api
title: Save a page-to-JSON config as a reusable API
